test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

Nandini said to Minal, "What shall I give you on your birthday next year?"

options.text: Nandini asked Minal what she would give her on her birthday the following year.
Nandini asked Minal what she would give her on her birthday the previous year.
Nandini asked Minal what she should give her on her birthday next year.
Nandini requested Minal what she should give her on her birthday the coming year.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** Nandini asked Minal what she would give her on her birthday the following year.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Reporting Verb:** "said to" changes to **"asked"** because the direct speech is an interrogative sentence (a question).
